sentences.en: The saiga, a species of antelope native to Central Asia, once roamed the vast grasslands of this region in enormous herds, many millions strong.
sentences.zh: 赛加羚羊原生于中亚，过去曾成群结队地漫游在当地广袤的草原上，种群数量达数百万只。

sentences.en: Regrettably, such spectacular sights are a thing of the past.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，如此壮观的景象已成往事。

sentences.en: Today, the saiga is largely confined to a single country: Kazakhstan.
sentences.zh: 如今，赛加羚羊主要集中在一个国家，即哈萨克斯坦。

sentences.en: This country is estimated to be home to well over 90% of the global saiga population, with Russia, Mongolia and Uzbekistan accounting for the rest.
sentences.zh: 据估计，哈萨克斯坦境内的赛加羚羊占全球总数的比例远高于90%，其余分布在俄罗斯、蒙古和乌兹别克斯坦。

sentences.en: The saiga is perfectly adapted to the tough conditions of the remote wilderness of the steppes of Central Asia.
sentences.zh: 赛加羚羊能很好地适应中亚偏远草原荒野的严酷环境。

sentences.en: One such adaptation is its bizarre bulbous nose, which enables the animal to survive the extreme seasonal temperature swings of the region.
sentences.zh: 这类适应性特征之一，是它形状奇特、鼓胀如球的鼻子，使它能够经受当地剧烈的季节性温差。

sentences.en: The swollen nostrils of the nose serve several purposes: they filter out dust and cool the blood during hot, dry summers, and they warm the cold air before it enters the saiga's lungs in winter.
sentences.zh: 它膨大的鼻孔有好几种作用：在炎热干燥的夏季，能滤去灰尘、冷却血液；到了冬季，又能在冷空气进入肺部之前将其加温。

sentences.en: Other seasonal adaptations include a heavy winter coat that the saiga sheds when the weather warms up.
sentences.zh: 它也有其他适应季节变化的特征，例如冬天长着厚实的皮毛，天气转暖时就会脱去。

sentences.en: Despite these superb adaptations to harsh conditions, the saiga has no defence against the threats posed by humans.
sentences.zh: 尽管赛加羚羊出色地适应了恶劣环境，面对人类带来的威胁，它却毫无防御能力。

sentences.en: It was almost driven to extinction by hunters in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 19世纪，猎人的捕杀一度使赛加羚羊濒临灭绝。

sentences.en: Legal protection ensured its survival for a while, and numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 法律保护一度保障了它的生存。在20世纪的大部分时间里，种群数量稳步回升。

sentences.en: But the respite was only temporary.
sentences.zh: 但这段喘息之机只是暂时的。

sentences.en: In the ten years following the break-up of the former Soviet Union in 1991, over 95% of the global population was lost – one of the fastest examples of species loss ever recorded for a mammal.
sentences.zh: 1991年苏联解体后的十年间，全球赛加羚羊数量减少了95%以上。放眼有记录的哺乳动物个案，这也是种群数量下降最快的例子之一。

sentences.en: The dramatic decline during this decade was due to illegal poaching on an industrial scale.
sentences.zh: 这十年间数量暴跌，是因为非法偷猎达到了工业化的规模。

sentences.en: Male saiga are a particular target, because their horns are highly prized by traditional medicine practitioners.
sentences.zh: 雄性赛加羚羊尤其容易成为目标，因为传统医药从业者十分看重它们的角。

sentences.en: Poaching reached epidemic levels after misguided conservationists tried to relieve the pressure on threatened African rhinos by actively encouraging the use of saiga horns in traditional medicine as an alternative to those of rhinos.
sentences.zh: 赛加羚羊偷猎之所以猖獗起来，是因为一些保护人士想减轻濒危非洲犀牛面临的压力，却用错了方法。他们积极鼓励人们在传统医药中用赛加羚羊角代替犀牛角。

sentences.en: Male saiga were almost wiped out, leading to a population crash from which the species has been struggling to recover ever since.
sentences.zh: 雄性赛加羚羊几乎被猎杀殆尽，导致整个种群数量骤降。此后，这一物种一直艰难地恢复着。

sentences.en: Another threat to the survival of the saiga is loss of habitat, as a result of agricultural expansion and human settlement.
sentences.zh: 赛加羚羊的生存还受到另一种威胁：农业扩张和人类定居导致它们的栖息地不断丧失。

sentences.en: Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species.
sentences.zh: 铁路、管道和围栏等实体障碍会阻断赛加羚羊的季节性迁徙路线，而这种动物的活动范围跨越国界。

sentences.en: In the worst cases, herds may starve to death after being trapped.
sentences.zh: 在最糟的情况下，羊群受困后可能活活饿死。

sentences.en: Then there is the risk of disease.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有疾病的威胁。

sentences.en: In 2015, an outbreak of haemorrhagic septicaemia, caused by the normally harmless bacterium Pasteurella multocida, killed over 75% of the global adult saiga population in just three weeks.
sentences.zh: 2015年，一种通常无害的细菌——多杀性巴氏杆菌——引发出血性败血症暴发；短短三周内，全球超过75%的成年赛加羚羊因此死亡。

sentences.en: In 2017, 60% of the Mongolian saiga population – a subspecies found nowhere else in the world – was killed by a virus that spilled over from livestock.
sentences.zh: 2017年，一种由家畜传来的病毒夺去了蒙古赛加羚羊种群中60%个体的生命。这个亚种仅分布在蒙古。

sentences.en: These so-called mass mortality events represent an unpredictable and serious threat to the species.
sentences.zh: 这些所谓的“大规模死亡事件”难以预测，对这一物种构成严重威胁。

sentences.en: Climate change poses a further threat.
sentences.zh: 气候变化带来了又一重威胁。

sentences.en: Although well adapted to cold winters and hot summers, saiga struggle to cope with temperature extremes and unpredictable fluctuations in climate.
sentences.zh: 尽管能很好地适应寒冬酷暑，赛加羚羊还是难以应对极端气温和难以预料的气候波动。

sentences.en: Experts believe that unusually warm weather may have triggered the 2015 mass mortality event.
sentences.zh: 专家认为，异常温暖的天气可能触发了2015年的大规模死亡事件。

sentences.en: The steppe region has also become increasingly arid in recent years, and many of the smaller streams that the species normally depended on have dried up and vanished.
sentences.zh: 近年来，这片草原也愈发干旱，许多赛加羚羊通常赖以生存的小溪都已干涸消失。

sentences.en: Recent efforts to save the saiga have been spearheaded by the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, a project led by the Association for the Conservation of Biodiversity of Kazakhstan, working in partnership with the Kazakh government's Committee for Forestry and Wildlife, Frankfurt Zoological Society and Fauna and Flora, an international conservation charity.
sentences.zh: 近年来，拯救赛加羚羊的行动一直由阿尔滕达拉草原保护倡议推动。这个项目由哈萨克斯坦生物多样性保护协会牵头，合作方包括哈萨克斯坦政府林业和野生动物委员会、法兰克福动物学会，以及国际自然保护慈善机构“野生动植物保护国际”。

sentences.en: Its purpose is to protect and restore Kazakhstan's steppe, semi-desert and desert ecosystems and the many species they support, including the critically endangered saiga.
sentences.zh: 该项目旨在保护和恢复哈萨克斯坦的草原、半荒漠和荒漠生态系统，以及依赖这些生态系统生存的众多物种，其中就包括极度濒危的赛加羚羊。

sentences.en: In 2022 the United Nations recognised the initiative as a World Restoration Flagship project, an accolade reserved for the ten best examples of large-scale ecosystem restoration around the globe.
sentences.zh: 2022年，联合国将这项倡议列为“世界生态恢复旗舰项目”。这项荣誉只授予全球大规模生态系统恢复工作的十个最佳范例。

sentences.en: So, how many saiga are there now?
sentences.zh: 那么，现在究竟有多少只赛加羚羊呢？

sentences.en: By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all-time low of just 21,000 individuals.
sentences.zh: 到2000年，全球赛加羚羊数量跌至有记录以来的最低点，只剩2.1万只。

sentences.en: There was some recovery in the first decade of the new millennium but this was then crushed by devastating mass mortality events that saw the loss of hundreds of thousands of the species.
sentences.zh: 新千年的头十年，种群数量一度有所恢复，但随后几次毁灭性的大规模死亡事件夺去了数十万只赛加羚羊的生命，令复苏势头戛然而止。

sentences.en: But thanks to the intervention of the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, the most recent episodes in the ongoing story of the saiga have been relatively uplifting.
sentences.zh: 不过，多亏阿尔滕达拉草原保护倡议介入，在赛加羚羊尚未结束的命运故事中，最近的进展比较令人振奋。

sentences.en: Three years ago, the Ustyurt Plateau population in Kazakhstan experienced its largest mass birth of saiga calves in many years.
sentences.zh: 三年前，哈萨克斯坦乌斯秋尔特高原的赛加羚羊种群迎来多年来规模最大的一次集中产仔。

sentences.en: An aerial census two years ago recorded an estimated 842,000 saiga across Kazakhstan as a whole, and according to an aerial survey earlier this year, the saiga population in Kazakhstan now exceeds 1.9 million.
sentences.zh: 两年前的一次空中普查估算，哈萨克斯坦全国约有84.2万只赛加羚羊；而据今年早些时候的空中调查，该国赛加羚羊数量如今已超过190万只。

sentences.en: The world's strangest-looking antelope remains critically endangered, but the direction of travel is positive.
sentences.zh: 这种世界上模样最奇特的羚羊仍处于极度濒危状态，但种群的变化趋势正在向好。
